_comment: TREND filter: inside what uptrend the pullback is bought. Sweeps the EMA pair whose EMAFast > EMASlow condition is entry gate 3 (36 evaluations). 5/50 is a near-local trend that flips often; 20/200 is a weekly-scale trend with few but sturdier entries. EMASlow is also the most expensive parameter for warm-up — it sets the 2*need+20 floor of Lookback — so a 200-bar slow line needs a longer candle window than the volume baseline does. Everything else inherits DefaultParams. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker GAZP -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_trend.json -out ./reports/GAZP_trend -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor. GAZP is only the example instrument here: this file sweeps one theme and is ticker-agnostic, so replace -ticker and -out to calibrate another name (e.g. -ticker T -out ./reports/T_trend, adding -refresh on a ticker whose candle cache is short).
